Clementine has a lot of the feature you want. Most "premium"* media players have all the "bells and whistles" features that you are used to. The organization and meta data of your music should all be picked up and displayed almost exactly as they are in itunes, if not better. Clementine has MusicBrainz integrated - which is a community driven lyric/metadata/album art aggregation service that works really well, and will cover you on the songs that don't have the given info. The linux version has a feature that the windows one doesn't though - desktop notifications via libnotify. *premium: meaning full featured and polished. with visually attractive menus. It's still completely free.
